description_en: Queries the upgrade status of a cluster component by calling DescribeClusterAddonUpgradeStatus
description_zh: 调用DescribeClusterAddonUpgradeStatus查询集群组件升级状态
kebab_example: aliyun cs describe-cluster-addon-upgrade-status --cluster-id c106f377e16f34eb1808d6b9362c90000 --component-id cloud-controller-manager --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClusterAddonUpgradeStatus

parameters.description_en:
The component ID, such as nginx-ingress-controller, flexvolume, or metrics-server.

You can call the DescribeAddons API operation to query the components supported by a cluster.
